mapper.insert: insert into br_stock_ledger (material_id, mark_type, biz_type, biz_table, biz_id, goods_source_type, goods_source_no, work_no, batch_no, qty, balance, create_time) values (#{materialId}, #{markType}, #{bizType}, #{bizTable}, #{bizId}, #{goodsSourceType}, #{goodsSourceNo}, #{workNo}, #{batchNo}, #{qty}, #{balance}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select ifnull((select balance from br_stock_ledger where material_id = #{materialId} order by id desc limit 1), 0)
select ifnull(sum(qty), 0) from br_stock_ledger where material_id = #{materialId} and goods_source_type = #{goodsSourceType} and goods_source_no = #{goodsSourceNo}
